name: csv-data-processing-system
description: Full-stack CSV data processing and storage system

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && serve -s build
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset
